units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 15:10">Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 10</cite>.—Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ bot. <he>רעדת … ושְׁקוֹעַת</he> the earth shook and sank.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>חמי בגרמיה דש׳ באריסותיה</he> when he sees that he is sinking (going back) in his tenancy.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:3">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>שָׁקִיעַ ביתא</he>, v. <cite ref="L00239"><he>לְוַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 4:20">Targ. Y. II, Num. IV, 20</cite> (h. text <he>בלע</he>).—Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>כד מְשַׁקַּע</he>, v. <cite ref="B00037"><he>באנטרין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Menachot 96a:19">Men. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>קנים שַׁקּוּעֵי משקע להו</he> as to the staves, he may have stuck them (into the bread before it was baked).
Ab. Zar. 75ᵇ חזי … לשַׁקּוּעֵיה he saw that the gentile (that pawned it) intended to forfeit it; a. e.—Part. pass. מְשַׁקַּע inlaid; engraven. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (some ed. מְשֻׁקַּע Hebraism).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 25:33">Targ. Y. Ex. XXV, 33</cite>, sq. <he>מְשַׁקְּעִין</he> (h. text <he>משקדים</he>).

senses.gloss: to sink, go down; to be immersed, flooded.
